params.name: fieldSetId
params.description:
The ID of the field set.

Example: `4aef602b-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-08d76696f678`

params.name: fieldsCustomDataFilters
params.description:
An comma-separated list that limits the fields to return:

- `IsRequiredOnCreate`: include fields that are required in room creation.
- `IsRequiredOnSubmit`: include fields that are required when submitting a room for review.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The globally unique identifier (GUID) for the account.

items.docs: Returns a field set. This is a set of fields that can appear on a room's Details tab in the console, such as `contactName` and `phone`.
